title: Chapter 309: A First Glimpse Into The Secrets Of The World
content:
Chapter 309: A First Glimpse Into The Secrets Of The World

Leaving the subsequent battles in the desert battlefield to the Queen, Wu Qing's consciousness returned to his body.

The rewards of the world rules have brought huge benefits to the Zerg and the forces belonging to the Zerg. As the master of the Zerg, Wu Qing has certainly gained greater benefits.

Wu Qing's mind moved, and his body's strength easily broke through to the seven-star level. The momentum of the breakthrough rose all the way, unstoppable, and continued to break through the bottleneck of the eight-star level, reaching the peak strength of the eight-star level, and then slowly stabilized.

Wu Qing felt his current strength. Because his body's qualifications are extremely high, the system has consumed all his strength to carry out the maximum transformation, so his current strength is much stronger than when he had the eight-star strength.

Quietly comprehending, having part of his former strength again, he felt a lot and had a deeper understanding of the essence of cultivation.

Wu Qing's spiritual power at this moment is also much stronger than when he was at the same level of strength. The rules of this world have been eroded and broken. He stood in the base camp of the Zerg territory, and just a thought moved the world.

He now has the strength to fight a large army alone, and he can use part of his former strength.

With Wu Qing's understanding of the rules of heaven and earth, and his current strength, this world under the suppression of the world's rules can hardly threaten his existence.

If the Queen of Insects descends to assist him in the battle with some spiritual power, and the powerful people of various races come in person, he will not be afraid.

"The power of the great clan is the shortcut to becoming powerful in this world. The race with the status of a great clan will definitely have powerful people in the clan!"

"This not only affects the rise and fall of the race, but also determines the height of personal cultivation. No wonder the competition is so fierce!"

Wu Qing understands the importance of the status of a great clan in this world, and has higher expectations for the Zerg to obtain the status of a great clan.

Wu Qing's current strength is enough to protect himself, and he is in a very good mood.

In the past, for safety, he always used his clone to show up, and his original body was always in the safe mother nest.

Now if necessary, his original body can also show up. With the unfathomable Queen of Insects, he is not afraid of mysterious and weird things now.

The continuous development of the Zerg means that the Queen of Insects is growing stronger. The Zerg has achieved such a great improvement, and the improvement of the Queen of Insects can be imagined.

Even if those evil gods who don't know whether they are real or fake come in person, the Queen of Zerg can now easily kill the gods.

With the full unlocking of Zerg technology and the rapid development of Zerg, under the continuous research of the Queen of Zerg, it has already had a certain degree of control over its own enormous power.

Regarding the weirdness, Wu Qing got some hints from the Goblins and the Naga. Although the two tribes did not say it explicitly, Wu Qing already understood that when the Zerg obtains the status of a large tribe, they will face the problem of weirdness.

This shows that the harm of weirdness to this world is no less than the invasion of foreign gods and races. The major tribes of the local camp are still fighting against weirdness on the secret front.

From the current known situation, weirdness is considered a third-party camp. Whether it is the local camp or the evil god camp, weirdness treats them equally.

This can explain why the two fundamentally opposing camps, the local camp and the evil god camp, can still maintain a certain restraint in the confrontation. Various default unspoken rules should be caused by certain external forces.

Now it seems that weirdness is this external force.

All of this needs to be considered after the Zerg obtains the status of a large tribe.

What needs to be done now is to make the Zerg gain the status of a large tribe as soon as possible.

…

Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg have already made a plan for the next direction of the Zerg's attack.

The super tribe of the alien race is still not moving, so keep it for now. It is not easy to find an opponent for a super tribe.

The next race that the Zerg will attack is the demon tribe.

It is definitely not enough to take down the demon territory near the Zerg territory. Wu Qing's idea is to attack the hinterland of the evil god camp along the Endless Mountains and attract the large tribes of the evil god camp to attack.

This route of attack along the Endless Mountains will not rob the defense lines of various races in the Free Land. Except for the demon tribe, the other attacks of the Zerg will not affect the existing defense lines of the local camp.

Faction battles are a burden and consumption for some races, but for other races, it is a shortcut to develop races. Before the Zerg gains the status of a large tribe, it is best not to break the existing pattern.

Wu Qing will add a seven-star Zerg Queen and a seven-star Zerg Scorpion to each detachment based on a standard Zerg air force detachment of more than 500,000 troops.

The seven-star troops are strong and their attacks are limited, so it is not advisable to deploy too many of them. It is enough to have eight-star strongmen who can threaten the enemy at a critical moment.

If a strong battle is really to be launched, the six-star Zerg troops can be upgraded to seven-star immediately.

The upgrade of six-star strength to seven-star in this world is a huge threshold, and the combat power will be qualitatively improved.

But in fact, the essence of the strength improvement in this world has not changed. This situation is caused by the suppression of world rules and the incompleteness of the world rules themselves.

Therefore, the resources consumed by the Zerg troops from six stars to seven stars are increased at a normal rate, and there is no exaggerated resource consumption.

The strength threshold set by the world rules has no effect on the strength improvement of the Zerg troops.

This is the power of the system. The rules of this world can even erode those foreign gods who don’t know whether they are true or false, which is not worth mentioning for the system.

The system is fighting against the will of the universe in which this world is located. As long as this world gives Wu Qing a little convenience, the system can make a big fuss about it.

The result now is that the seven-star powerhouses that are very precious in this world, the Zerg only need to consume normal resources to break through and improve without limit, and are not suppressed by the rules of the world.

This completely violates the will of the world rules. The world rules are considered to have been poked by a hidden big hole by the system.

…

The second Zerg sub-base at the junction of the Zerg forbidden land territory and the Endless Mountains and the Demon Territory.

Wu Qing consumed a lot of resources and built ten more standard-sized Zerg air forces, increasing the size of the Zerg air force to twenty-three.

Two of them fought against the aliens in the public battlefield of the southern theater, one fought in the demon territory, and ten fought in the desert battlefield. Together with the newly built ten, there are exactly twenty-three.

Now each standard-sized Zerg air force has a seven-star Zerg Queen, a seven-star Zerg Scorpion, ten six-star Zerg Queens, ten six-star Zerg Scorpions, ten six-star Zerg Mammoths, ten thousand five-star Zerg Air Guards, ten thousand five-star Zerg Devourers, and five hundred thousand one-star Zerg Dragons.

There are also auxiliary arms such as Zerg Hosts, Zerg Exploding Swarms, and Transport-type Zerg Hosts of various star levels.

These more than 10 million Zerg air main combat forces have become the core combat power of the Zerg army, with super high mobility, flexibility, and attack capabilities.

The air force detachments that have participated in many battles, with the blessing of the world rule authority, have many Zerg individuals who have autonomously improved their strength levels in many arms.

The Zerg has an increasing world rule authority, and these Zerg air forces will become stronger and stronger.

After the ten Zerg air forces of the Zerg second sub-base were built, they flew to the hinterland of the demon territory.

The Zerg host has explored the entire Demon Territory and has a very detailed understanding of the Demon Territory.

This Demon Territory is like the battlefield where the Naga and Skeletons fought. It is a battlefield territory outside the Demon Territory. It gathers a large number of Demon troops, but it is not the core of the Demon Territory.

Because the Demon Territory is facing various races in the Southern Free Land. These races in the Free Land are all races that have not obtained the status of a large tribe. The combined ordinary combat power is very strong, but in terms of high-end combat power, it is still lacking compared with the large tribes.

It will be more difficult for ordinary races to increase their strength to more than six stars, not to mention creating a great power in the tribe, which is even more difficult.

But difficulty does not mean that there will be no success. There are still many races that have extremely strong foundations by virtue of continuous accumulation. They unite, and the evil god camp needs a large tribe like the Demon Tribe to come and sit.

Because of these reasons, the situation in this Demon Territory is very delicate. The power invested by the Demon Tribe is not weak, but it cannot be compared with the battlefield territory of the Naga Tribe.

This information is not very meaningful to the Zerg. To sum up, the Zerg may not gain as much from conquering the Demon Tribe territory as from driving away the desert race.

If the gains are small, then we have to fight as soon as possible and create some troubles so that the evil gods in the evil god camp who hate the Zerg will come to trouble the Zerg.

Wu Qing now has to prepare a large battlefield to actively attract the forces of the evil god camp, so that the Zerg will not have to find them one by one, which is too troublesome.

Originally, a Zerg air force was fighting in the Demon Tribe territory, and the pressure on the Demon Tribe was not too great. In addition, there was a confrontation between the army of the Southern Free Land on the front line, so the speed of gathering troops in the Demon Tribe territory was not fast.

When the Zerg army launched a large-scale attack, the large army of the Demon Tribe was still scattered in three regions, and did not realize the huge danger that was about to come.

When the demon army of tens of millions of people encountered the Zerg army with the same lineup as the desert battlefield, it was really like an egg hitting a stone.

More than five million Zerg air forces pushed forward completely, and the Zerg puppies and three-type poisonous ray scorpions that cooperated on the ground followed up almost without any damage and cleaned up the remaining enemies.

After some of the six-star demons with extremely strong combat power in the demon tribe were parasitized and controlled by the six-star Zerg Queen, the rest were all eliminated by the elimination ability of the six-star Zerg scorpions to restore their energy and status.

The troops below the six-star level of the demon tribe had no ability to fight back under the attack of 100,000 five-star Zerg air guards and 100,000 five-star Zerg destroyers.
